title: Line interruption, switch feedback missing
description: Same break as S16, but the switch's feedback wire is disconnected, so no feedback signal ever arrives. The controller orders the shutdown, but nothing confirms it.
what_to_look_for: Status ISOLATION PENDING – it never changes to ISOLATED.
Shutdown commanded: Yes. Switch feedback confirms: No.
A 'Shutdown not confirmed' alert after about 3 s.

steps.note: Simulated conductor parts between Node A and Node B (switch feedback wire disconnected)

button.label: Isolation Not Confirmed
button.does: Same simulated broken wire, but the simulated switch sends no feedback signal. The shutdown is commanded but never confirmed.
button.wait: ISOLATION PENDING appears after about 4 s; the 'not confirmed' alert about 3 s later.

checks.text: Fault location: Possible interruption between Node A and Node B (estimate).
Switch feedback: Not confirmed (no confirmation within 3 s).
A 'Shutdown not confirmed by switch' event appears.
